name: monitoring-quality-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal monitoring improvement actions based on configuration data, alert metrics, and historical improvement outcomes

options.description: Reduce alert thresholds to catch issues earlier
Add new monitoring rules to improve coverage
Improve alert aggregation to reduce noise and false positives
Optimize monitoring frequency for better signal-to-noise ratio
Implement intelligent alerting with machine learning-based anomaly detection

evaluation_factors: Monitoring configuration completeness, alert noise level, and last incident recency
User feedback scores and satisfaction ratings for current monitoring quality
Historical success rates for each improvement action in similar monitoring scenarios
Time sensitivity and potential impact on users during monitoring improvement process
Risk of introducing new issues with more invasive monitoring approaches
